macros.name: datedate
macros.doc: \datedate: typesets the date, corresponding to the counters dateyear, datemonth, dateday.

macros.name: mynextdate
macros.doc: \mynextdate{yearcount}{monthcount}{daycount}: Sets the counters yearcount, monthcount, and daycount to the next date.

macros.name: nextdate
macros.doc: \nextdate: Sets the counters dateyear, datemonth, and dateday to the next date.

macros.name: prevdate
macros.doc: \prevdate: Sets the counters dateyear, datemonth, and dateday to the previous date.

macros.name: setdate
macros.doc: \setdate{year}{month}{day}: Sets the counters dateyear, datemonth, and dateday to year, month, and day.

macros.name: setdatebynumber
macros.doc: \setdatebynumber{number}: Sets the counters dateyear, datemonth, and dateday to values, which corresponds to the number.

macros.name: setdatenumber
macros.doc: \setdatenumber{year}{month}{day}: Sets the counter datenumber to a value, which corresponds to the date.

macros.name: setdatetoday
macros.doc: \setdatetoday: Sets the counters dateyear, datemonth, and dateday to the current date.

macros.name: setmydatebynumber
macros.doc: \setmydatebynumber{number}{yearcount}{monthcount}{daycount}: Sets the counters yearcount, monthcount, and daycount to values, which corresponds to the number.

macros.name: setmydatenumber
macros.doc: \setmydatenumber{numbercount}{year}{month}{day}: Sets the counter numbercount to a value, which corresponds to the date.

macros.name: setstartyear
macros.doc: The start of the counting is determined with \setstartyear{year} (standard 1800).
